dedupe_keys.name: mysa remote sensing open data catalogue malaysian space agency

description: The Malaysian Space Agency runs an open data catalogue for satellite raster data received at its satellite data receiving station in Temerloh, Pahang, or from other sources. Under the MYSA Open Data Initiative, unrestricted optical satellite data with spatial resolution coarser than 5 metres can be downloaded: NOAA, MODIS, Landsat TM and SPOT 1 to 5 imagery, supplied in raw format and subject to what is available in the MYSA archive. The terms state that all rights belong to the satellite owners (NOAA, NASA, USGS and Airbus Defence and Space), that use is limited to non-commercial purposes under each owner's end user licence agreement, that publications must acknowledge the satellite owners and MYSA, and that access will be rolled out in stages; named customer service officers handle enquiries. Access is free under these terms. Caveats: the data is raw, not analysis-ready, only optical and medium-to-coarse resolution data is included, and commercial use is not allowed. Coverage is Malaysia and the region seen by the receiving station. It supports hazard exposure and land change analysis, such as flood and haze monitoring around infrastructure; related records are Digital Earth Australia and the NLSA Satellietdataportaal.
